status: confirmed source cancellation defect, runtime sample consistent
observed: Main thread idle in NSApplication run, not joining child or blocked in GPU call.
No Rust lifecycle worker in sampled thread inventory. Remaining helpers are SwiftShader workers, NSEvent thread and work queue.

source_cause.unix.rs:811-819: register_signals installs INT/TERM/HUP atomic-only handlers and discards unregister handles.
source_cause.unix.rs:1066-1069: Only lifecycle worker consumes the cancellation atomic in gameplay loop.
source_cause.startup.rs:223-248: Nonzero Finished with cancel0 retains failure UI and completed result, leaving loop alive.
source_cause.startup.rs:258-259: Main thread sleeps indefinitely under ControlFlow::Wait and has no cancellation event handler.
source_cause.startup.rs:89-94: Post-run cancellation+join is unreachable while retained failure UI stays alive.

conclusion: After lifecycle worker finishes with failure, TERM changes an atomic that has no remaining consumer and does not wake/dismiss UI. This explains repeated TERM having no effect without an owned-child cleanup deadlock. Sample cannot directly inspect Startup.result, but log, absent worker, and idle UI match this path.
minimal_proposal_for_root_review: Add an event-driven signal bridge spanning the entire graphical launcher lifetime, including retained failure UI. Signal-safe handler must only write to a pipe/set atomics; normal reader thread sends winit Update::Interrupted(status).

Handle interruption on UI thread by setting shared cancel. If result already exists, replace retained result with Ok(interrupt_status) and exit loop immediately. If worker active, preserve current owned-process cleanup, then return interrupt status after Finished; cancellation must suppress retained error UI.
Own and close/unregister signal listener with RAII. Join its reader after close so normal Quit does not retain a helper. Keep headless behavior and status mapping INT130/TERM143/HUP129.

signal-hook iterator feature is currently disabled. Enabling iterator adds only its channel feature in signal-hook0.3.18, with no new dependency package. This is a proposed implementation option, not an applied change.
required_validation: Pure state regression for failure then interrupt, interrupt then failure, and successful completion.
Fresh process regression: synthetic failing owned child, retained GUI failure event loop, actual identity-owned TERM, bounded launcher exit without KILL. Verify children gone and lock released.
Headless cancellation remains bounded and unrelated processes survive; no idle polling introduced.
Rebuild affected ARM/Intel/Linux launcher and starter only after root review; carry frozen production PE/native/shaders with exact origins.
secondary_observation: No failure window visible in VM screenshot, and nil-device presentation warnings persist. Do not infer that the failure display rendered successfully merely because surface object exists. This UI issue is separate from the confirmed signal-handling omission.
